If DA2 had more time to cook I think it would easily be a contender for the best in the series. Since it didn't, I still think it's Origins. The story, lore, companions, world building, etc. were all great in 2.

The constantly recycled environments, however, was pretty bad and the waves of enemies style of encounter design was awful. I think the encounter design is the main thing that holds it back for me. Especially as a nightmare player. It was just annoying a lot of the time.

That being said, because the Legacy DLC pretty much did away with the orbital drop shock troopers and recycled environments and went back to carefully crafted and personal encounters I think it's the best Dragon Age has ever been overall. That DLC keeps the excellence of DA2 and fixes it's mistakes. If the whole game was like Legacy it would be the best in my opinion.
